scope: Travis County (Austin, Pflugerville, Manor, Del Valle) - healthcare, mental health, school/childcare, employment, legal

records.name: MAP (Medical Access Program) and MAP Basic
records.description_en: MAP is local health coverage for Travis County. It covers primary care, prescriptions, specialty care, and hospital care.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For uninsured Travis County residents with household income at or below 200% of the Federal Poverty Level (about $2,660 a month for one person). You cannot have Medicaid, Medicare, or private insurance.
documents_needed: Proof of Travis County address (lease, utility bill, or mail postmarked in the last 30 days)
Picture ID for each adult (driver's license, state ID, foreign ID, or passport)
Proof of U.S. citizenship or residency status, if you have it (birth certificate, permanent resident card, or passport)
Proof of household income for the last 30 days (pay stubs, Social Security or retirement letter, unemployment letter)
Proof of household size (birth certificates or IDs for household members)
Any insurance card you have (Medicaid, Medicare, or private)
records.how_to_apply: Apply online at the Central Health application portal, or call 512-978-8130 and choose option 1 to apply by phone or set an in-person appointment. You can also mail an application to Medical Access Program, PO Box 300489, Austin, TX 78703.
records.cost: Free or low cost for eligible members
records.notes: Interpreters are available by phone; ask for your language when you call. Eligibility is based on income from the last 30 days. MAP members get care at CommUnityCare and other partner clinics.

records.name: CommUnityCare Health Centers - Patient Navigation Center
records.description_en: CommUnityCare runs community health centers across Travis County. They offer primary care, children's care, women's health, dental, behavioral health, HIV care, lab, and pharmacy.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to everyone, with or without insurance and regardless of ability to pay. Call to be screened for help paying your bill.
records.how_to_apply: Call the Patient Navigation Center at 512-978-9015 to make your first appointment, or book online through MyChart. Ask the financial screening team about payment help before your visit.
records.cost: Accepts insurance; financial assistance for people who qualify
records.notes: Federally Qualified Health Center network. Call agents are bilingual and translation services are available for other languages. Main clinic partner for Central Health MAP members.

records.name: CommUnityCare Del Valle Health & Wellness Center
records.description_en: A community clinic in Del Valle with family medicine, children's care, women's health, dental, behavioral health, lab, and a pharmacy.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to everyone, with or without insurance. Payment help is available for people who qualify.
records.how_to_apply: Call the clinic at 512-978-9760 to make an appointment, or call the Patient Navigation Center at 512-978-9015.
records.hours: Clinic: Monday - Friday 7:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Pharmacy: Monday - Friday 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m.
records.cost: Accepts insurance; financial assistance for people who qualify
records.notes: Pharmacy phone: 512-716-7070. Lab is open Tuesday and Thursday 8 a.m. - 5 p.m. (closed noon-1 p.m.).

records.name: CommUnityCare Manor Health Center
records.description_en: A community clinic in Manor with family medicine for adults and children and women's health care.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to everyone, with or without insurance. Payment help is available for people who qualify.
records.how_to_apply: Call 512-978-9780 to make an appointment.
records.hours: Clinic: Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday 7:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.
records.cost: Accepts insurance; financial assistance for people who qualify
records.notes: Clinic is open only Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. For other CommUnityCare locations call 512-978-9015.

records.name: CommUnityCare Pflugerville Health Center
records.description_en: A community clinic in Pflugerville with family and internal medicine, pediatrics, women's health, counseling, and dental care.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to everyone, with or without insurance. Payment help is available for people who qualify.
records.how_to_apply: Call 512-978-9840 for medical appointments or 512-359-9404 for dental.
records.hours: Monday - Thursday 7:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m.; Friday 7:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.; Saturday 8:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m.
records.cost: Accepts insurance; financial assistance for people who qualify
records.notes: Dental line: 512-359-9404. Has evening and Saturday hours.

records.name: CommUnityCare Clinic at ARCH (Health Care for the Homeless)
records.description_en: A clinic inside the ARCH shelter downtown for people experiencing homelessness. It offers primary care, behavioral health, case management, lab, vision care, and disease screening.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Only for people experiencing homelessness.
records.how_to_apply: Walk in during clinic hours or call 512-978-9920 to make an appointment.
records.hours: Monday - Friday 7:30 a.m. to 11:30 a.m., 12:30 p.m. to 4:30 p.m.
records.cost: Free or low cost; financial assistance available
records.notes: Closed for lunch 11:30 a.m. - 12:30 p.m. Offers TB, hepatitis, HIV, and STD screening and PrEP/PEP.

records.name: People's Community Clinic
records.description_en: A community health center offering care for children, teens, and adults, prenatal and family planning care, dental, pharmacy, lab, shots, and behavioral health.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to people with or without insurance. Fees are lowered on a sliding scale based on household income and size, and no one is turned away for inability to pay.
documents_needed: Insurance card, if you have one (Medicaid, CHIP, Medicare, or private)
Proof of address showing your county
One recent pay stub or proof of income from the last 30 days (for the sliding scale)
records.how_to_apply: Call 512-478-4939 (option 1, then option 1) to make an appointment with a patient services representative.
records.cost: Sliding scale; accepts Medicaid, CHIP, and Medicare
records.notes: Other sites: Women's Health at 1025 East 32nd Street, Suite 200, Austin 78705, and a Manor location off US 290 behind Manor New Tech High School. All phone representatives speak English and Spanish. Sliding-scale income proof must be updated every year.

records.name: Lone Star Circle of Care - Austin and Pflugerville Clinics
records.description_en: A community health center network with family medicine, pediatrics, OB/GYN, and behavioral health clinics in Austin and Pflugerville.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to the public. Call to ask about insurance and payment help.
records.how_to_apply: Call the central appointment line at 877-800-5722 to schedule at any clinic.
records.address: 1221 W. Ben White Blvd., Building B
records.notes: Travis County sites include Ben White (1221 W. Ben White Blvd.), Stassney (730 W. Stassney, Ste 110), Northwest Austin (11111 Research Blvd.), Collinfield (8913 Collinfield Dr.), El Buen Samaritano (7000 Woodhue Dr., Bldg B), MoPac North (12201 Renfert Way), Oak Springs (3000 Oak Springs), Pediatrics at St. John (6937 N. I-35, Ste 3), and Pflugerville (1501 W Pecan St, Ste 102). Hours and sliding-fee details were not on the page; ask when calling.

records.name: Volunteer Healthcare Clinic
records.description_en: A free clinic run by volunteers. It offers primary care for short-term and long-term illnesses, lab tests, prescriptions, and some specialty care.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For uninsured Travis County residents with household income at or below 200% of the Federal Poverty Level.
records.how_to_apply: Call 512-459-6002 and press 0 for eligibility and registration. First visits are usually at the Tuesday or Thursday evening clinic.
records.hours: Daytime: Monday - Thursday 9:30 AM - 2:00 PM. Evening: Tuesday & Thursday 6:00 PM - 10:00 PM.
records.cost: Free; a $10 donation is appreciated but not required
records.notes: Located at the corner of Medical Parkway and 43rd Street. Good option for uninsured people who do not qualify for other programs.

records.name: Hope Medical Clinic
records.description_en: A free clinic offering primary care, medicines, chronic disease care, and health education.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For uninsured people in the Austin area, including resettled refugees.
records.how_to_apply: Text 512-768-8609 to make an appointment. The scheduler replies within one business day.
records.cost: Free; a $20 donation is requested if you are able
records.notes: Appointments required. For questions that are not about appointments call 512-766-9979.

records.name: El Buen Samaritano
records.description_en: A community center in South Austin offering vaccines and health education, adult education and job support, food access, and rent help.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Serves families in the Austin area. Call to ask which services you qualify for.
records.how_to_apply: Call 512-439-8900 or visit the center during business hours.
records.notes: A Lone Star Circle of Care medical clinic operates at the same address (7000 Woodhue Dr., Building B; call 877-800-5722). Eligibility and languages were not stated on the page; Spanish is inferred from the organization's bilingual name and should be confirmed.

records.name: WIC (Women, Infants and Children) - Austin Public Health
records.description_en: WIC gives healthy foods, nutrition education, breastfeeding support, and referrals to pregnant women, new mothers, and young children.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For pregnant women, new mothers, and young children who meet WIC rules. Services are free to those who are eligible.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online at texaswic.org/apply or call the WIC scheduling center at 512-972-4942 for an appointment.
records.hours: Scheduling center: Monday - Thursday 7:30 a.m. - 4:30 p.m.; Fridays 7:30 a.m. - 1:30 p.m.
records.notes: Travis County clinics include St. John (7500 Blessing Ave.), Northwest (8701 Research Blvd., Ste A), Montopolis (2901 Montopolis Dr., Ste 1300), Far South (405 W. Stassney), Dove Springs (5811 Palo Blanco Ln), Manor (14008 Shadow Glen Blvd, Ste 207), Pflugerville (15822 Foothill Farms Loop), and Del Valle (3518 FM 973). The South Austin clinic (2508 Durwood St.) was listed as closed for building repair. Rosewood-Zaragosa and Oak Hill are served part-time by the mobile unit. Also serves Bastrop County.

records.name: Integral Care (Local Mental Health Authority for Travis County)
records.description_en: Integral Care is the public mental health agency for Travis County. It offers crisis help, counseling, psychiatry, medicine management, and substance use treatment, plus services for intellectual and developmental disabilities.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For anyone in Travis County affected by mental health conditions, substance use, or intellectual and developmental disabilities.
records.how_to_apply: Call the 24/7 helpline at 512-472-4357 (512-472-HELP) for crisis support, appointments, or information about services.
records.notes: Toll free: 844-398-8252. TTY: 512-703-1395. The 512-472-HELP line is also the local crisis line. Spanish availability is assumed from the bilingual site and should be confirmed by phone.

records.name: Psychiatric Emergency Services (PES)
records.description_en: A walk-in urgent care clinic for adults, children, and families having a mental health crisis. It offers care plans, medicine, short-term support, and links to other services.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For adults, children, and families in a mental health crisis. No appointment needed.
records.how_to_apply: Walk in to the Richard E. Hopkins Behavioral Health Building. Call 512-472-4357 first if you want to check current hours.
records.notes: Hours were not shown on the location page and third-party sites conflict; confirm by calling 512-472-HELP. Separate waiting rooms for adults and for families with children. In a life-threatening emergency call 911; the national 988 line is also available.

records.name: Austin Child Guidance Center
records.description_en: Mental health care for children and young people, including individual and family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing, in person or by video.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For youth up to age 26 and their families. Fees are lowered on a sliding scale based on income, family size, and living costs.
records.how_to_apply: Call 512-451-2242 to schedule.
records.cost: Sliding scale (full fee is $160 per therapy session)

records.name: The SAFE Alliance - 24/7 Hotline and Survivor Services
records.description_en: SAFE helps survivors of domestic violence, sexual assault, trafficking, and child abuse. It offers a 24/7 hotline, shelter and housing, legal help, and counseling.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For survivors of child abuse, sexual assault and exploitation, and domestic violence.
records.how_to_apply: Call 512-267-7233 (512-267-SAFE) any time, text 737-888-7233, or use the chat on the website.
records.hours: Hotline 24/7. Advocacy and crisis intervention: Monday-Friday, 8 a.m. to 4 p.m.
records.notes: Shelter address is confidential; mailing address is P.O. Box 19454, Austin, TX 78760. Admin line: 512-369-5900. Text line: 737-888-7233.

records.name: Child Care Services (Child Care Scholarships)
records.description_en: Helps low- to moderate-income families in Travis County pay for child care and find approved child care providers.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Parents must work or go to school or training: at least 25 hours a week for a single parent, or 50 combined hours for two parents. Income limits depend on family size.
records.how_to_apply: Apply on the Workforce Solutions Capital Area website or call 512-597-7191. If no spot is open, you can fill out a form to join the waitlist.
records.cost: Subsidized; families may pay a share of cost
records.notes: Email: austinccs@wfscapitalarea.com. A findhelp.org listing (secondary source) shows monthly income limits of about $3,988 for a household of 1 and $7,670 for a household of 4; confirm current limits with the office. There is often a waitlist.

records.name: Head Start and Early Head Start
records.description_en: Free early learning for young children, plus health, dental, mental health, disability services, and family support. Early Head Start serves babies and toddlers; Head Start serves 3- and 4-year-olds.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Travis County families who meet Federal Poverty Guidelines, or whose child is in foster care, has a disability, is homeless, or whose family gets TANF, SNAP, or SSI.
documents_needed: Proof of income (2025 tax return, W-2, employer letters, or pay stubs)
Proof of other income (unemployment, child support, or benefits letters)
records.how_to_apply: Apply online at any time, or call 512-451-7361 and ask for an eligibility specialist.
records.notes: Early Head Start: 6 weeks to 36 months (center or home-based). Head Start: ages 3-4 by September 1. Families above the poverty line may still qualify through foster care, disability, homelessness, or TANF/SNAP/SSI.

records.name: Austin ISD Free and Reduced-Price School Meals
records.organization: Austin ISD Nutrition and Food Services
records.description_en: Free or low-cost breakfast and lunch for Austin ISD students. Many schools give free meals to all students with no application.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Austin ISD students. At schools that are not on the free-for-all (CEP) list, families apply based on income each school year.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online at SchoolCafe.com/AustinISD, pick up a paper form at a school front office, or email a completed form to foodservicebusinesssupport@austinisd.org.
records.notes: A new application is needed each school year. Schools needing applications in 2026-27 include some elementary schools, several middle schools, and Anderson, Austin, Bowie, LASA, McCallum high schools and Ann Richards; all other schools serve free meals automatically. Mailing address: 4000 S. I-H 35 Frontage Rd., Austin, TX 78704.

records.name: Del Valle ISD Free School Meals (CEP)
records.organization: Del Valle ISD Child Nutrition Department
records.description_en: All Del Valle ISD students get free breakfast and lunch.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Every student enrolled in Del Valle ISD. No meal application is needed.
records.how_to_apply: No meal application needed. Families should fill out the Socioeconomic Form on the district's family portal.
records.notes: District says free meals are guaranteed through the 2026-2027 school year under the Community Eligibility Provision.

records.name: Manor ISD Free School Meals (CEP)
records.description_en: All Manor ISD students get free breakfast and lunch for the 2026-27 school year.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Every student enrolled in Manor ISD. No application or documents needed.
records.how_to_apply: No application needed; enrolled students get free meals automatically.
records.notes: Main district line: 512-278-4000. CEP fact sheets are available in English and Spanish.

records.name: Pflugerville ISD Free and Reduced Meals
records.organization: Pflugerville ISD Food and Child Nutrition Services
records.description_en: Free or reduced-price school meals for Pflugerville ISD students whose families qualify.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Pflugerville ISD students. Families apply using the Free and Reduced Meals Application and Socioeconomic Information Form.
records.how_to_apply: Fill out the Free and Reduced Meals Application and Socioeconomic Information Form from the district's Food and Child Nutrition Services page.
records.notes: Phone and CEP campus list were not shown on the page; see the department staff directory on pfisd.net. The district also reaches into Williamson County.

records.name: Workforce Solutions Capital Area - North Career Center
records.description_en: A free career center that helps people find jobs, get job training, and plan careers.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to job seekers in Austin and Travis County.
records.how_to_apply: Call 512-381-5100 to make an appointment, or walk in during office hours.
records.notes: Appointments line: 512-381-5100. Appointments are encouraged but walk-ins are accepted. Vocational rehabilitation (for people with disabilities): 512-485-3734. Text line for Career Info Sessions: 512-719-4145.

records.name: Workforce Solutions Capital Area - East Career Center
records.description_en: A free career center in East Austin that helps people find jobs, get job training, and plan careers.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to job seekers in Austin and Travis County.
records.how_to_apply: Call 512-381-4200 or walk in during office hours.
records.notes: Appointments are encouraged but walk-ins are accepted.

records.name: Capital IDEA
records.description_en: Pays 100% of college tuition and gives coaching for working adults training for high-demand careers, such as healthcare and technical jobs.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Adults 18 and older with a high school diploma or GED and no college degree, who live in Travis, Williamson, Hays, Bastrop, or Caldwell County, have lived in Texas 12+ months, are U.S. citizens or permanent residents, and meet income limits.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Travis, Williamson, Hays, Bastrop, or Caldwell County resident; Texas resident 12+ months

records.how_to_apply: Check eligibility on the website, then join a free 30-minute info session (online or in person) and meet with a career guidance specialist.
records.notes: Income limits depend on household size; use the online checker. Participants commit to finishing, working in Central Texas at least 2 years after graduating. Info session list: https://www.capitalidea.org/info-sessions/

records.name: Goodwill Central Texas Career Services (Goodwill Community Center)
records.description_en: Free career coaching, job readiness classes, resume help, interview practice, job training, and adult high school (The Excel Center).
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to the public. Some programs have their own rules, such as The Excel Center for adults ages 18-50.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the Goodwill Community Center during intake hours or call 512-637-7100.
records.hours: Intake Hours: Monday-Friday 8:30AM - 4:30PM; Lobby Hours: Monday-Friday 8:00AM - 5:00PM
records.notes: Also: Goodwill Resource Center - Job Help Center, 6505 Burleson Rd, Austin 78744, 512-681-3301 (intake M-F 8:30-4:30); Oak Hill Career Center, 7100 US-290 Suite C, 512-288-7700 (by appointment); Goodwill Career and Technical Academy, 512-637-7131.

records.name: YouthBuild Austin
records.description_en: Young people earn a GED or high school diploma while getting paid to learn a trade in healthcare, manufacturing/IT, or construction. Case management and basic needs help are free.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For young people ages 16 to 24.
records.how_to_apply: Fill out the interest form on the American YouthWorks website and a recruiter will contact you, or call 512-744-1900.
records.notes: American YouthWorks also runs the Texas Conservation Corps and Austin Civilian Conservation Corps (paid conservation job training).

records.name: Texas RioGrande Legal Aid - Austin Office
records.description_en: Free civil legal help for low-income people, including eviction defense, family law, domestic violence, public benefits, and job issues.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income residents of the 68 Texas counties TRLA serves, including Travis County. Income rules apply.
records.how_to_apply: Call (833) 329-8752 toll-free or (956) 996-8752 on weekdays, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m., to apply for free legal help.
records.hours: Phone line: weekdays 9:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m. (Central Time)
records.notes: TRLA is the main legal partner for eviction defense in Austin/Travis County. BASTA (Building and Strengthening Tenant Action), a TRLA project, educates tenants about their rights but does not give direct help to individuals or money.

records.name: Volunteer Legal Services of Central Texas
records.organization: Volunteer Legal Services of Central Texas (VLS)
records.description_en: Free legal advice and limited representation from volunteer lawyers for civil problems like landlord-tenant, family, consumer, employment, bankruptcy, wills, and record clearing.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people who cannot afford a lawyer. Help depends on household income, assets, where you live, and the type of case. Does not handle criminal, immigration, or civil rights cases.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online through the VLS website or go to one of their free legal advice clinics. VLS does not take applications by phone, email, or in person at the office.
records.notes: Call 512-476-5550 with questions about eligibility or Travis County legal clinics. Secondary sources say VLS serves Travis, Williamson, Bastrop, and Hays counties and has volunteer attorneys at Travis County JP eviction dockets.

records.name: American Gateways - Immigration Legal Services
records.description_en: Free or low-cost immigration legal help for immigrants, refugees, and survivors of persecution, torture, conflict, and human trafficking.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to anyone who meets their income guidelines and case priorities.
records.how_to_apply: Call (512) 478-0546 ext. 200 to ask for an appointment.
records.notes: Use extension 200. Also has offices in San Antonio and Waco. Fills the gap left by TRLA/VLS for immigration cases.

records.name: Travis County Community Centers (Health and Human Services)
records.organization: Travis County Health and Human Services
records.description_en: Neighborhood offices run by Travis County that help with utilities, food pantry, home repairs, weatherization, and social work.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Travis County residents in need. Call the nearest center to ask what help is available and what the rules are.
records.how_to_apply: Call or visit the community center closest to you.
records.notes: Other centers: Del Valle, 3518 FM 973 S., 512-854-1520; Manor, 600 W. Carrie Manor St., 512-854-1550; Pflugerville, 15822 Foothill Farm Loop, Suite D, 512-854-1530; Oak Hill, 8656 A State Hwy 71 West, Suite 100, 512-854-2130; Jonestown, 18649 FM 1431, Suite 6A, 512-854-1500. The page does not list which services each center offers or hours; call first.
